case_origins.baseline-history: historical market; manually conservative neutral structure
case_origins.conflicting-evidence: historical market plus explicitly synthetic conflicting statements
case_origins.sparse-evidence: synthetic sparse derivative without directional facts

limitations: Not a full four-timeframe strategy input
Neutral structure is a conservative fixture, not a calculated historical trend
Twelve hourly candles do not establish a long-term outlook
No historical news or proprietary article content copied
Retrospective retrieval is not proof of point-in-time availability; market evidence observed_at is retrieval time, the content identifies the historical window
